title: Fluffy wavy Edgar
caption: A fictional young Latino man wearing a fuller Edgar with a blunt fringe, tight faded sides and visibly wavy volume through the upper section.
patternDescription: Presented with a Type 2B-like wavy texture that creates more lift and separation through the top while retaining a recognizable blunt Edgar fringe.
lengthDescription: Short through the faded sides and back, with moderately longer hair retained through the top to create a fuller textured silhouette.
